description_en: Creates a pay-as-you-go instance and returns the instance ID and order ID
description_zh: 创建后付费实例并返回实例ID和订单ID
name: CreatePostPayInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The disk type. Valid values:

0: ultra disk

1: SSD
This parameter is not required if you create a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘类型。取值：

0：高效云盘

1：SSD
若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk capacity.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.
This parameter is not required if you create a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘容量。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。
若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

4: Internet- and VPC-connected instance

5: VPC-connected instance
parameters.help_zh:
部署类型。取值：

4：公网/VPC实例

5：VPC实例
parameters.name: deploy_type

parameters.help_en:
The Internet traffic.

This parameter is required if DeployType is set to 4.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

This parameter is not required if you create a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
公网流量。

如果DeployType为4，则需填写。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: eip_max

parameters.help_en:
The number of partitions to purchase.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.
This parameter is not required if the instance is a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
购买分区数。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。
若实例为Serverless实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: partition_num

parameters.help_en:
The billing type. Valid values:

1 (default): pay-as-you-go for reserved instances.
3: pay-as-you-go for serverless reserved specifications + pay-as-you-go for serverless elastic scaling
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：

1（默认）：预留实例后付费。
3：Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费
parameters.name: paid_type

parameters.help_en:
The specification type.

Valid values when PaidType is set to 1 (pay-as-you-go for reserved instances):

normal: Standard Edition (shared throughput)
professional: Professional Edition (shared throughput)
professionalForHighRead: Professional Edition (shared throughput for high read)

Valid values when PaidType is set to 3 (pay-as-you-go for serverless reserved specifications + pay-as-you-go for serverless elastic scaling):

basic: Serverless Basic Edition
normal: Serverless Standard Edition
professional: Serverless Professional Edition

For more information about the specification types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html
parameters.help_zh:
规格类型。

当PaidType参数为1（预留实例后付费）时取值：

normal：标准版（高写版）
professional：专业版（高写版）
professionalForHighRead：专业版（高读版）

当PaidType参数为3（Serverless实例预留规格后付费+Serverless弹性伸缩后付费）时取值：

basic：Serverless基础版
normal：Serverless标准版
professional：Serverless专业版

以上规格类型的说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html
parameters.name: spec_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic specification.

For the value range, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html.

This parameter is not required if you create a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
流量规格。

取值范围，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/84737.html。

若创建 Serverless 实例，无需传该参数
parameters.name: io_max_spec

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

If this parameter is not specified, the instance is placed in the default resource group. You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Management console
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

不设置时落在默认资源组里，可在资源组控制台查看资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource.
N ranges from 1 to 20.
If this parameter is left empty, all tag keys are matched.
The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。
N为1~20。
如果为空，则匹配所有标签键。
最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource.
N ranges from 1 to 20.
If the tag key is left empty, this parameter must also be left empty. If this parameter is left empty, all tag values are matched.
The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。
N为1~20。
如果标签键为空，则必须为空。为空时，匹配所有标签值。
最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The reserved publish traffic specification value. Only integers are supported. The minimum value is 60. This parameter is required for serverless instances.


The actual upper limit is subject to the inventory in the current region. Refer to the purchase page for the available range
fields.help_zh:
预留的发送流量规格值，仅支持传入整数，最低 60。Serverless实例必传。


实际上限受当前地域库存影响，请参考售卖页可选范围
fields.name: reserved_publish_capacity

fields.help_en:
The reserved subscribe traffic specification value. Only integers are supported. The minimum value is 20. This parameter is required for serverless instances.

The actual upper limit is subject to the inventory in the current region. Refer to the purchase page for the available range
fields.help_zh:
预留的消费流量规格值，仅支持传入整数，最低 20。Serverless实例必传。

实际上限受当前地域库存影响，请参考售卖页可选范围
fields.name: reserved_subscribe_capacity

parameters.help_en: The settings for the serverless instance. This parameter is required when you create a serverless instance
parameters.help_zh: Serverless实例的相关设置。创建 Serverless 实例时必传
parameters.name: serverless_config

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
